gloss: best in Japan, Japan's number one

definitions.gloss: best in Japan, number one in Japan
definitions.explanation: The top or finest in all of Japan. Used to describe something that ranks first nationwide in some quality or measure.

examples.japanese: {日本一|にっぽんいち}の{山|やま}は{富士山|ふじさん}だ。
examples.english: The tallest mountain in Japan is Mt. Fuji.

examples.japanese: {日本一|にっぽんいち}{高|たか}いビルに{登|のぼ}った。
examples.english: I went up the tallest building in Japan.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}のラーメンは{日本一|にっぽんいち}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: This restaurant's ramen is said to be the best in Japan.

notes:
Can be read as either にっぽんいち or にほんいち, but にっぽんいち is more common in this expression.

Used as a noun modifier with の, or as a predicate:
・{日本一|にっぽんいち}の〜 (the best ~ in Japan)
・〜は{日本一|にっぽんいち}だ (~ is the best in Japan)

Often used with superlative-like expressions ({高|たか}い, {大|おお}きい, {長|なが}い, etc.).
